annotations.title: Create a Google Business Profile listing

description: CREATE a new Google Business Profile listing in the connected Google account — putting a new business on Google Search and Maps. Run search_google_listings first so it does not duplicate one that exists. Required: title (the real-world name), languageCode (e.g. "en", never changeable), primaryCategory (a Google category id from list_business_categories, e.g. "categories/gcid:coffee_shop"), and storefrontAddress {regionCode, addressLines, locality, administrativeArea, postalCode} and/or serviceArea. Optional: additionalCategories, phone, websiteUri, description, regularHours, businessAccountId (when the Google login manages several Business Profile accounts). Google VALIDATES it first on every call (validateOnly) and nothing is created until confirm:true after the user saw the listing; dryRun:true only validates. The new listing is shared with this brand straight away, and must then be verified (manage_business_verification) before it shows on Maps. The brand owner only. 0 credits.

businessAccountId.description: accounts/… — the Business Profile account, only when the Google login manages several

confirm.description: true ONLY after the user approved creating this exact listing

description.description: the business in its own words

dryRun.description: validate with Google and create nothing

languageCode.description: BCP 47, e.g. "en" — set once, never changeable

requestId.description: any stable id (≤50 chars): a retry with the same id cannot create a second listing
